author: KEXP
description: Traditional Isan folk music meets modern electronic sounds under the musical project TONTRAKUL. With traditional northeastern Thai instruments like the khaen and phin, the group share a performance of "Isan Lum Long (อีสานลำล่อง)" and more Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival.
title: TONTRAKUL performs "Isan Lum Long (อีสานลำล่อง)" & more Live on KEXP
